notes.title: v1.4 Major update!
notes.content:
Biographies and other databases optimization.
Game tutorial optimization.
Units support optimization.
Since the first chapter, a large number of NPCS and new dialogue, events, and content can be freely explored.
Each level has added mission suggestions for the level, which are additional tips that are different from the tutorial.
When the items are full, you will get new items, and will be prompted to throw one of them away. Important items cannot be thrown away, and the warehouse character can choose to put them in the warehouse.
During the attack preparation phase, a confirmation window is displayed when you press the space bar to quickly attack.
Our character's head turns red and flashes when HP minimal.
Fixed a bug where the terrain of the mission target location became flat.
Limit Wood's ability to pick up items at will on Mount Gilead, and avoid a bug later in the Battle of Hogback where he can't automatically get weapons and ammo because he's full of scavenged items.
History message, which in some cases predisplays the following short piece of content has been fixed.
The first episode of Mr. And Mrs. Wood's arrival at Hogback Hill was reworked to avoid the previous misalignment.
There are other optimizations.

ps: The version number of the start game main menu still shows v1.3.2.1, you can check whether the update has been downloaded by looking at the main menu layout and the new database option.

Torian

notes.title: v1.3.2 Comprehensive optimization
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726027/f28df4590e34cdd0bb9c326600aeaa80ab02f7d4.png[/img]

[b]World Map[/b]

This afternoon, I spent eight hours designing and drawing fonts to optimize the map. I had to identify the abbreviations of the state names (in fact, they were different in ancient times), which states required abbreviations (usually very small states), and how the fonts were arranged. This time the start screen is finally a little bit more reasonable. But that's not the end, it's just the beginning of optimization. The map that I used for the start screen and the description of the world situation, I wanted it to be like the Lord of the Rings, with mountains, rivers, cities and villages dotted around. Give me enough sponsorship, and I'll give you a better story than Lord of the Rings.

Sponsored link：https://afdian.net/p/28dac9e0d25511ec8bfa52540025c377

Or support me by buying the game!

[b]Materials[/b]

What if Sharps runs out of ammo and can't get ammo? I believe this is the problem of all friends who love Sharps rifles. Of course, from the historical literature, people at the time had the same problem, so they decided to make their own. This time, in the Lawrence Stronghold after the battle of "Protect Free Blacks", an event to create paper shells for Sharps rifles is added, and players can choose whether to create a batch of paper shells for Sharps rifles.

[b]Other[/b]

New black powder, lead, paper three material props, can be bought in the corresponding stronghold.
Added.54 caliber bullets for the Harpers Ferry 1803 rifle.
The buffalo rifle was changed to a.48 instead of a.52 caliber round
Springfield 1795 sold for zero bug, fixed.
Simpson's Dutch musket was corrected to.79 caliber.
Add intelligence about the Dutch musket in Kansas City, the stronghold of the BORDER RUFFIAN in Chapter 5.
In the stronghold of Chapter 8 [People's Assembly] Lawrence can make round balls.79 caliber.
John Brown Jr. and Jason Brown, who had virtually no horses at Camp Brown, were unable to ride.
Samuel Wood's drawn height is reduced, which also makes the proportions more pleasing, and the height gap with the other characters more reasonable.
Changed: Wounded status movement will also be affected.
Four new heroes were added: Ritchie, Redpath, Phillips and Reese P. Brown.
Hunt for Coleman: Add grocery stores in Louisiana town this level.
In preparation for the battle against the BORDER RUFFIAN, Simpson and Deitzler were able to prepare in the ranks.
There are other optimizations.

Torian

notes.title: v1.3 Major update!
notes.content:
This update will continue the content of v1.2, a comprehensive variety of ammunition, all characters initially carried, available, shop ammunition all reworked, which will further increase the supply and combat strategy!

New features for other weapons are also being redesigned to take into account the new counter-attack features added to the revolver.
The counterattack characteristics of the revolver are indeed very powerful, and you should think twice before you encounter any enemy armed with a revolver, so in addition to the range to avoid counterattack, there are other weapons that can suppress the revolver?
This time, the original design of the double-barreled shotgun increased the suppression effect of the revolver, which could avoid the counterattack of the revolver. Due to the characteristics of long-range rifles, revolvers and double-barreled shotguns, they form a restraint relationship between them, and this restraint relationship is included in other more abundant weapon types, greatly enriching the supply and combat strategy.
We can now declare a new level of balance of weapons, no longer a single long range rifle, but each weapon has its own advantages. Since each weapon has a corresponding type of ammunition, and ammunition supplies are limited, this prevents players from only stockpiling a certain type of gun (or only stockpiling a long range rifle).
However, even without supply constraints, just buying a long-range rifle is no longer the best option. In order to deal with the enemy who may be equipped with a variety of weapons, we must also enrich the types of weapons in the warehouse!

Next update preview: Big Map Travel and new elements in travel

This time, there will be a complete overhaul of the big map system, which will involve a lot of different areas of work, the most obvious being hand-drawn new big maps. Before simplified the big map part, after all, the big map is more or less independent of the main plot and combat system, the priority is not so high, so it is not detailed, this time finished the other parts, finally can do a good job of this part.

Torian

notes.title: Campaign Mode: the next update will be officially opened
notes.content:
The new mode is officially called Campaign Mode.

The next update will officially open up the Campaign Mode.    It will continue to update the content of the mode, such as new characters, new levels.    Each time I add these, the amount of work and complexity increases exponentially, but I step by step do it.

The next three screenshots show the new Mode selection interface, which is a mix of Chinese and English.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726027/9e8ccaf88e0e084d6fe6520948b6dbeb5484a4f6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726027/5c9e8dd7a25cbc7c9b34dcec04cef59400e7b57b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726027/7a181f567cf0fea79544391b9600ce417bc63c44.png[/img]

The final screenshot shows the four characters that have been recruited in Campaign Mode (there are more characters that can be recruited). Take a closer look at the blonde angel, which seems to be a pixel taller than the other characters, and very faithfully restores the tall and straight figure of the young man...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726027/323d53713bb42b7949aba724adac7095e3d54fca.png[/img]

The Campaign Mode not only includes all the characters from the Story Mode, but also recruits troops like the 7th New York State Militia that are NPC in the Story Mode.

The next update will also raise the price appropriately, and bring more and better content.
